key_concepts: Measuring is a science process skill that makes observations more accurate.
Rulers and metersticks are tools for measuring length, height, and width.
A double-headed arrow shows measuring distance from one point to another.
Length is measured from one end of an object to the other end.
Leaves have length and width that can be measured with tools.
Measuring leaf length and width can show plant growth because leaves get bigger as plants
Predicting is a science process skill that uses observed patterns to guess or infer future
Good observations are needed to identify patterns and make predictions.
Dark clouds and lightning are observations that can lead to a prediction of rain.
Plant growth follows a pattern from seedling to young tree to mature fruit-bearing tree.
Real-life events such as plant growth, water level changes, and water behavior on surfaces
